Echo uses your contacts only when you ask, for example to text or call someone or add a new contact. Echo never deletes contacts.
Echo listens only after you tap the orb, use Hey Echo, or press the voice button, so you can ask a question or give a command.
Echo can save guide images and organize photos into albums when you ask it to.
Echo opens your latest screenshot when you ask for help, and Photo Cleanup groups screenshots, big videos and duplicates. Nothing is deleted unless you pick it and confirm.
